title: The Lilac Buds Are Watching
skyStory: Waxing gibbous, seventy-six percent, still in Virgo and still holding the clipboard. The moon is getting rounder and slightly smug about it. It has been checking on the lilac buds every night this week, measuring them with a tiny cosmic ruler. They are, it reports, on schedule. Mars wants them to bloom now. Saturn says lilacs answer to no one.

reading: Getting fuller, getting louder. Ideas will come thick and fast today, and the cabin's walls will be covered in sticky notes by sundown if you're not careful. Write them down, yes. But choose one to water. The rest can sit in the seed tray for now.

Around 10:30 a message will arrive asking for your help. Before you say yes, ask for something in return, even something tiny, like a coffee or a recommendation. The [[Six of Pentacles]] has been waiting all year for you to practise this. It will feel strange, like writing with your other hand. Do it anyway. The scales balance a little.
joel.mission: When someone asks you for a favour today, ask for one small thing back, out loud, and accept it gracefully.
joel.omen: A bird stealing string from a fence to build a nest. Taking what you need is how homes get built.

reading: The shore is thawing in earnest now. Tidal pools are warming up and something small and alive will catch your eye at the edge of the water or the edge of a puddle. A snail, a minnow, a beetle dressed for a wedding. Stop. Look closely. That's your Life Path 11 sending a postcard.

The message on the postcard: small things are paying attention. Today, the minor kindness you do without thinking, holding a door, remembering a name, is noticed by someone who needed it. You won't hear about it. That's fine. The [[Six of Swords]] crossing gets easier with every small kindness stacked in the boat.
nancy.mission: Learn the name of one person you see regularly but have never actually spoken to, and use it.
nancy.omen: A ladybug on your sleeve or windowsill. Something delicate is on its way; leave room for it.

together.text: Start a lilac watch. Each of you find one lilac bush near you and send a photo of its buds today. Repeat every few days. The first to send a full bloom wins bragging rights until June. Saturn will be adjudicating, slowly.

game.intro: The lilac buds have been watching all week. Nobody knows what they saw. You decide.
game.headline: LILAC BUDS CAUGHT ___ ON BACKYARD CAMERA, NEIGHBOURHOOD DEMANDS ANSWERS
